fields.description: Al Ghadeer Parks is a 453-home Aldar neighbourhood offering two- and three-bedroom townhouses alongside four-bedroom villas. Set between Abu Dhabi and Dubai, it combines private family homes with shared recreation space, shaded walkways and access to the wider Al Ghadeer community.

overview: The community is organised around outdoor recreation and pedestrian routes. A central gathering space, play areas, shaded paths and event lawns provide shared facilities beyond the private homes. The brochure offers light and dark interior schemes; its light scheme uses porcelain flooring and counters with timber-look joinery, rather than implying all visible surfaces are natural stone or solid timber.
research.locationNote: Al Ghadeer Parks is within the Al Ghadeer community in Seih Al Sedeirah, between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Check the actual plot entrance and commute route; promotional airport timings are not a journey guarantee.
research.priceNote: Aldar lists two-bedroom townhouses from AED 1.9m, three-bedroom townhouses from AED 2.2m and four-bedroom villas from AED 3.3m. Secondary launch sheets quote higher three-bedroom middle/corner prices. Confirm the exact layout and current offer rather than treating these as equivalent units.
research.paymentNote: The developer states 55/45 with 5% down. The dated stages below are reported by an independent project marketing site; verify them with Aldar. Together booking and construction total 55%, with 45% at handover.
research.handoverNote: Q 2 2031 is Aldar's advertised handover target. Property Finder also lists June 2031. Confirm the selected release's contractual date and conditions for possession.
